references.text: The same ritual with blood on the right earlobe, right thumb, and right big toe is used in the cleansing of a leper, showing the connection between priestly consecration and cleansing.
Oil is applied to the same places as the blood in the cleansing ritual, confirming the pattern established in the priestly consecration.
The blood from the guilt offering is applied to the right earlobe, right thumb, and right big toe, identical to the priestly consecration ritual.
The oil is applied to the same places as the blood, following exactly the same pattern as in Aaron's consecration.
This is the original instruction from God to Moses about applying blood to Aaron's right earlobe, thumb, and big toe during the consecration.
The same ritual is then performed on Aaron's sons, showing that all priests had to undergo this consecration.
